title: Sea Turtle Cottage Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutSea Turtle Cottage ~ 68 Sea Turtle Drive ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. Sea Turtle Cottage is a family-friendly Gulf front home on a quiet gated street in Seagrove Beach. With 3,705sq of living (2,572 interior), Sea Turtle Cottage sleeps up to 12 guests and offers 5 bedrooms, 4 baths, parking for 4 cars (one in garage), a yard perfect for lawn games, cozy fire pit and 50' of beach frontage accessed by private boardwalk. Sea Turtle Cottage is the ideal beachfront home you'll want to visit year after year for your family vacation, where 2nd and 3rd generations can grow and make memories to last a lifetime. Ground Level: 3 bedrooms. 2 baths. Vaulted living room (fireplace decorative only). Dining table seats 6, island seating for 4. Fully equipped kitchen. Garage with additional fridge, washer and dryer. Gulf front covered porch. #1 bedroom has a King bed #2 bedroom has 2 bunks (4 Twins) Full shared bath with tub shower, newly renovated bathroom! #3 En-Suite bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, Gulf front porch access, newly renovated bathroom! Second Floor: 2 bedrooms. 2 baths. #4 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, tub/shower, large closet to fit pack-n-play #5 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, stackable washer/dryer Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 6 Smart TVs (no local channels), 2 Blu-Ray/DVD player, CD player, puzzles, books, movies Distinctive Features Gulf front with private beach boardwalk with shower, foot wash Gated street Fire pit Large yard Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Garage parking for 1 vehicle, driveway parking for 3 vehicles 4 King beds, 2 Bunks (4 Twins) 4 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 4 hairdryers, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils, boardwalk shower and foot wash, outdoor porch, fire pit. Please note - No local cable channels on any Smart TV's; streaming services available with guest account login; living room fireplace is decorative only (not for guest use). Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, Keurig,electric range, 2 refrigerators, ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, 2 washers, 2 dryers, separate ice maker. Linens Provided - No Smoking - No Pets. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Grayton Beach (5 miles) Seaside (2.5 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
